sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 0 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 1 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 4 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 5 THEN 'Friday'
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM published_at) = 6 THEN 'Saturday'
  END AS day_of_week,
  COUNT(*) AS num_listings
FROM
  fct_posting
WHERE
  remote_us = TRUE AND is_open = TRUE
GROUP BY
  day_of_week
ORDER BY
  num_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
